journal.text: Oren supplied a trail blade, a lantern, three tonics and a salve for an injured animal. Find the northern mine.
A Place Beside the Road accepted. Vessa supplies the fittings. Choose the shelter or river stand after returning. Fee: 10 sunmarks, 2 timber, 4 meadow fibre; no XP or personal-material cost.
Vessa’s labelled braces and ties are carried. These supplied job parts are separate from equipment and ordinary inventory.
The supplied canopy is fitted over the existing settlement bench. Inspect the worker’s sheltered sorting place.
The matched braces are seated and the road worker has a usable place. Return to Merren for the declared fee.
Merren recognizes your sheltered sorting place. +10 sunmarks, +2 timber, +4 meadow fibre, paid once. The crossing route-board design is learned; craft and place it deliberately at home.
Home project pinned: Crossing route-board. Reading or pinning accepts no commission.
Crossing route-board made once. Choose a retreat position deliberately; nothing was placed or replaced.
